title: Local Polynomial Estimation in Irregular Correlated Random Coefficient Panel Data Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.32846v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study estimation of the average partial effect (APE) in an irregular correlated random coefficients panel data model in which the time dimension equals the number of random coefficients, $T=p$, and the density function is degenerate. We extend Graham and Powell (2012) in two directions. First, we allow the density of $d_i=\det(X_i)$ to vanish or diverge at the origin at the polynomial rate $|d|^{a}$ with $a>-1$, and show that the aggregate time effects and the APE remain identified for every such $a$, extending earlier work studying the case $a = 0$. Second, we propose a three-step estimator: an $m$th-order local polynomial regression over the stayers for the time effects; a local polynomial fit of the conditional mean coefficient just outside the trimming threshold; and an imputation step that extrapolates the latter into the stayer region rather than discarding stayers. translated_title: 非规则相关随机系数面板数据模型中的局部多项式估计
translated_abstract: 我们研究了非规则相关随机系数面板数据模型中平均偏效应（APE）的估计问题，该模型中时间维度等于随机系数的个数（$T=p$），且密度函数是退化的。我们在两个方向上扩展了Graham和Powell (2012) 的工作。首先，我们允许 $d_i=\det(X_i)$ 的密度函数在原点处以多项式速率 $|d|^{a}$（其中 $a>-1$）消失或发散，并证明对于每一个这样的 $a$，加总时间效应和APE仍然是可识别的，这扩展了此前仅研究 $a=0$ 情形的工作。其次，我们提出了一个三步估计量：对停留者进行时间效应的 $m$ 阶局部多项式回归；在修剪阈值外侧对条件均值系数进行局部多项式拟合；以及一个插补步骤，将后者外推到停留者区域而不是直接丢弃停留者。我们在三种不同情形下建立了联合渐近正态性。
tldr: 该文将Graham和Powell (2012) 的相关随机系数面板模型扩展至密度函数以任意多项式速率退化（$a>-1$）的非规则情形，证明了平均偏效应在此类情形下仍可识别，并提出了一种包含插补停留者步骤的三步局部多项式估计量。
en_tdlr: The paper extends Graham and Powell (2012) to irregular correlated random coefficient panel data models whose degenerate density vanishes or diverges at any polynomial rate ($a>-1$), shows the APE remains identified, and proposes a three-step local polynomial estimator featuring an imputation step for stayers.
